# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 17 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** moderately damaged

---

**17:1** I give thanks to You, O Lord, for You have made my face shine for Your covenant,

**17:2** and from [...] I seek You, and as surely as the dawn You come to me as flawless light.

**17:3** But they among Your people [...] led them astray, and speakers of falsehood smoothed their way,

**17:4** causing them to stumble without discernment. For [...] their deeds are done in frenzy.

**17:5** I am held in contempt by them; they accord me no worth

**17:6** even when You manifest Your strength in me. They banished me from my land

**17:7** like a bird from its nest, and all my companions and associates

**17:8** have been driven from me. They count me a shattered vessel.

**17:9** They -- interpreters of falsehood, seers of fraud --

**17:10** have devised wickedness against me, to replace Your teaching inscribed upon my heart

**17:11** with flattery for Your people. They deny the drink of knowledge to the thirsty

**17:12** and give them vinegar to quench their thirst, so that they stare upon

**17:13** their own delusion, raving at their festivals, ensnared in their nets.

**17:14** But You, O God, reject every design of Belial,

**17:15** and Your counsel alone endures, and the design of Your heart holds firm forever.

**17:16** They are dissemblers, plotting the intrigues of Belial;

**17:17** they seek You with a divided heart and are not grounded in Your truth.

**17:18** A root yielding venom and wormwood inhabits their thoughts,

**17:19** and in the obstinacy of their hearts they cast about; they seek You among idols,

**17:20** setting the stumbling block of their iniquity before their own faces.

**17:21** They come to seek You through the mouth of lying prophets, beguiled by error.

**17:22** With stammering lips and an alien tongue

**17:23** they address Your people, making a mockery of all their deeds through fraud.

**17:24** For they have not selected the way of Your heart, nor heeded Your word;

**17:25** they declared of the vision of knowledge: It is unfounded! And of the way of Your heart: It is not the way!

**17:26** But You, O God, will answer them, passing sentence in Your might

**17:27** according to their idols and the multitude of their offenses,

**17:28** so that they are trapped by their own designs, they who deserted Your covenant.

**17:29** You shall destroy in judgment every man of deceit, and visionaries of error shall be found no more.

**17:30** There is no delusion in any of Your works, no treachery in the purpose of Your heart.

**17:31** Those who accord with Your pleasure shall stand before You forever,

**17:32** and those who walk in the way of Your heart shall be established for all eternity.

**17:33** As for me, when I cling to You I rise and stand firm against my despisers,

**17:34** and my hand is raised against all who ridicule me. They grant me no honor

**17:35** even when You display Your power through me. For You appeared to me in Your strength at the break of day,

**17:36** and You have not veiled my face in disgrace [...] who seek You in the council of the community [...]

**17:37** [...] standing before You [...] forever.

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 17 is a polemical hymn against rival teachers. "Interpreters of falsehood" and "seers of fraud" are Qumran designations for opponents, possibly Pharisaic leaders. "Smooth things" (chalaqot) is a wordplay on halakhot (legal rulings).*
